[NLFC.10.1] **The build's capabilities.** libds must provide a public
query returning the capabilities it was built with, as values of
`proto/capabilities.proto#Capability`. It needs no engine. An integrator may
compare an artefact's `requires` against it before loading; a load of an
artefact requiring a capability the build lacks fails with
`DS_ERR_DSC_CAPABILITY_ABSENT` ([RDSC.16.2.7]).
